key.name: enable-downloads-stack
key.description: Show Downloads folder stack in dock

key.name: downloads-view-mode
key.description: View mode for Downloads stack: 'list' (fan) or 'grid' (4x6 grid)

key.name: enable-documents-stack
key.description: Show Documents folder stack in dock

key.name: documents-view-mode
key.description: View mode for Documents stack: 'list' (fan) or 'grid' (4x6 grid)

key.name: enable-custom-stack
key.description: Show user-specified custom folder stack in dock

key.name: custom-folder-path
key.description: Path to the custom directory for stack

key.name: custom-folder-icon
key.description: System icon name or image file path for Custom Folder stack icon

key.name: custom-folder-view-mode
key.description: View mode for Custom Folder stack: 'list' (fan) or 'grid' (4x6 grid)

key.name: enable-minimized-thumbnails
key.description: Park thumbnails of minimized windows on the dock

key.name: enable-dock-outline
key.description: Draw an outline border around the dock container

key.name: dock-outline-width
key.description: Width of dock outline border in pixels (0 to 5px)

key.name: dock-outline-color
key.description: Color of dock outline border in CSS format (hex or rgba)

key.name: dock-outline-auto-radius
key.description: Automatically match dock container corner radius

key.name: dock-outline-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels (0 to 30px) when auto corner radius is disabled
